newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady in limited test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady in limited test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a limited test, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was only fair. Seller interest minimal as the vast majority have already traded their showlists. Sales confirmed - 500 For the week - 103,500.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs - few 105.00- 106.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs - few 105.00- 106.00. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
